tagline: The live 微博热搜榜 as clean rows: organic rank, topic, heat count, Weibo's own badge and a direct search link, with ads removed.
intro: Weibo's hot search list (微博热搜) is where Chinese news, celebrity stories and brand crises surface first, and a topic can climb into the top ten within minutes. For PR teams and analysts outside China, watching it means refreshing a Chinese-language page and losing the history as soon as it changes.

This actor captures the current Weibo hot search board and returns each trending topic with its organic rank, heat count (热度), Weibo's badge as shown on the site (新 new, 热 hot, 沸 boiling, 爆 explosive) and a direct search link. Ads are removed and the pinned/government slot is excluded, so ranks reflect what is genuinely trending.

Use it for brand monitoring, PR and crisis alerts, China market research and news detection, or as a live China context tool for AI agents. Schedule it every 15 to 60 minutes to build a ranking history. Topics are $2 per 1,000, so the full top 50 costs $0.10 a run.
howItWorks: The actor fetches Weibo's live public hot search board; no login, cookies or configuration are needed.
Advertised entries are dropped and the pinned/government slot is excluded, so rank 1 is the top organic topic.
Each topic is written as a row with platform, rank, title, heat score, label and search URL.
The optional `keywords` filter keeps only matching topics, and topics it filters out are never charged.
If Weibo is temporarily unavailable, the run fails cleanly and nothing is charged.

faq.q: What do the 新, 热, 沸 and 爆 labels mean on Weibo hot search?
faq.a: They are Weibo's own badges: 新 marks a new topic, 热 a hot one, 沸 a boiling one and 爆 an explosive one. The actor returns them in `label` exactly as Weibo shows them, or null when a topic has no badge.

faq.q: Are ads included in the Weibo hot search data?
faq.a: No. Ads are removed and the pinned/government slot is excluded, so `rank` is the organic position with 1 as the top topic.

faq.q: How often should I scrape Weibo hot search?
faq.a: Every 15 to 60 minutes is enough to build a useful ranking history. Hourly top 10 for a month is about 7,200 topics, which costs $14.40.

faq.q: Does it collect Weibo user accounts or posts?
faq.a: No. It returns topics, ranks and heat only. No user accounts, profiles or personal data are collected.

faq.q: Can I get the Weibo trending list in English?
faq.a: Topics are returned in their original language, mostly Simplified Chinese, and are not machine-translated. Run the titles through your own translator or LLM if you need English.
